allowed_assumption_patterns.reason: Lean 4.34.1's native_decide adds one fresh axiom `<decl>._native.native_decide.ax_N_M : e = true` at each use, after the compiled decision procedure has evaluated `e` to true; the pattern admits exactly that name shape (the `_native.native_decide` infix is reserved for it) and stands for the native evaluator entry in the inventory. In DS-04 it appears only in the observation audits and, through `golden_certificate_accepted`, in D4-TH01

inventory.name: Lean 4.34.1 compiler, code generator, IR interpreter and runtime (native_decide, DS-04)
inventory.reason: widens the trusted base for DS-04 only. The observation method native_decide, and the single step `golden_certificate_accepted` (lrat_verdict carry_save (cnf_text carry_save) golden = accept) that D4-TH01 goes through, are decided by compiling the Decidable instance to IR and running it in the elaborator: the IR interpreter runs the D006.Lrat definitions (cnf_text, the LRAT parser and checker) and calls the compiled C of Init for String, ByteArray, List and GMP Nat primitives (String.toUTF8, utf8ByteSize, String.decEq, Nat.repr). The kernel does not re-run that evaluation; it accepts the fresh axiom above. Lean.ofReduceBool is deprecated in 4.34.1 and does not appear in the audits. Why not the kernel: a String literal reaches the kernel as String.ofList of its characters and its bytes come out of a push/append chain that is quadratic under kernel whnf, so `decide +kernel` cannot read a certificate: utf8ByteSize of a 16 KB literal took 23 s and 2.27 GB (1 KB: 3.4 s, 589 MB; the same file without the literal: 1.8 s, 469 MB), counting newlines in a 7.7 KB literal 68 s and 3.7 GB; the 62 KB golden certificate as per-line literals ran 600 s and 13.6 GB without finishing (left-nested join) or ran out of a 6 GB cap in 62 s (right-nested); as a 62 K-element UInt8 list it hit the heartbeat limit in 50 s; as Nat chunks, decoding plus length alone took 19 s and 1.7 GB and a newline count 56 s and 3 GB. The 4.2 MB V-08 literal is some 70 times larger. The soundness argument (D4-TH04, D4-TH02, D4-TH03, D4-TH05) is kernel-checked and native-free

inventory.name: the built D006.Lrat (.olean)
inventory.reason: imported by the DS-04 check file without re-checking at lean's default trust level; the same kernel checks every declaration in it when the build compiles D006/Lrat.lean, and its IR is what native_decide interprets for the observations

inventory.name: propext and Quot.sound (DS-04)
inventory.reason: already allowed by the base. D4-TH02, D4-TH03, D4-TH05 and D4-TH04 (with the whole checker soundness proof and the CNF correspondence) audit to propext and Quot.sound only; they enter through simp, omega and core lemmas. Classical.choice is kept out on purpose: omega only closes atomic goals and the classical core lemmas (Nat.mod_pow_succ, List.filter_eq_nil_iff, BitVec.carry_succ) are replaced by constructive proofs. D4-TH01 adds the native_decide axiom of golden_certificate_accepted
